fresh packaged CLI reload and batched continuation agree with uninterrupted playback

checks.head: af44da406acf7ab44436e978cb1f571b93e28d23

method: Build the production CLI using build:cli into a fresh dist-cli/rts.js, spawn it twice, send public JSON load/command/advance/save/result requests over stdin, compare complete native save JSON and checksum with a separately bundled direct-core reference every tick and command, then load a saved midpoint and continue in requests of at most 1200 ticks. Retain raw public stdin/stdout as gzip, CLI hash logs, process exits, native checkpoints and full source/build manifests.
limits: Public CLI load changes human controllers and sets the controlled side to external; this full-save verifier rejects those incompatible archives.
Only commands for one controlled external side and 0.05-second ticks are supported.
The generated fixture is a short economy and recruitment run, not a natural victory or a full tournament.
This verifier executes the packaged CLI. Browser/Node helper parity remains a separate check.
